column6: eval (() => { const hs = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4,h5')].filter(h => h.textContent.trim().startsWith('404')); return hs.map(h => h.id + ' | ' + h.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ')).join('\n'); })()

eval (() => { const hs = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4,h5')].filter(h => h.textContent.includes('404')); return hs.map(h => h.id + ' || ' + h.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ')).join('\n'); })()

eval (() => { const h = document.getElementById('name-404-not-found'); let p = h.nextElementSibling; while (p && !p.textContent.trim()) p = p.nextElementSibling; return p ? p.textContent.trim().slice(0,200) : 'none'; })()
